name: tilt-card
title: Tilt Card
description: A card that tilts in 3D toward or away from the pointer and scales up slightly, with an optional spotlight that follows it.
author: Spell UI <https://github.com/xxtomm>
docs:
Installed `TiltCard`. Import it from `@/components/ui/tilt-card` and style it like a card: `<TiltCard className="rounded-2xl bg-card p-6">…</TiltCard>`.

It tilts away from the pointer by default (`effect="gravitate"` tilts toward it), up to `tiltLimit` degrees, and scales by `scale` while hovered. Under reduced motion it stays flat and only the spotlight follows the pointer. The spotlight color is `--tilt-card-spotlight`.
